name: remote-turns-tracked-per-session
description: In remote mode two Claude sessions on this machine each start a turn. The first one's Stop ends only its own turn: the status stays thinking while the second session is still working, and goes idle only when that one stops too.
reason: Hooks fire for every Claude session on the machine, and several can be mid-turn at once. A single global working flag interleaved them, so one session's Stop turned the light idle while another was still working.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'per-session remote turn tracking' (remoteActiveTurns keyed by session id); AppState.handleRemoteEvent

script.reason: Session beta starts a turn of its own.
Alpha finishes. Beta is still working, so the status must not go idle.
Beta finishes: no session is working any more.
